mapper.select: SELECT id,name,parent_id,description,sort_no FROM question_bank_category ORDER BY sort_no ASC,id ASC
SELECT id,name,parent_id,description,sort_no,created_by FROM question_bank_category WHERE created_by=#{userId} ORDER BY sort_no ASC,id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT c.id,c.name,c.parent_id,c.description,c.sort_no FROM question_bank_category c INNER JOIN question_bank b ON b.category = c.name AND b.published = TRUE WHERE c.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.sort_no ASC,c.id ASC
SELECT id,name,parent_id,description,sort_no FROM question_bank_category WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id,name,parent_id,description,sort_no,created_by FROM question_bank_category WHERE id=#{id} AND created_by=#{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE question_bank_category SET name=#{name},parent_id=#{parentId},description=#{description},sort_no=#{sortNo},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND created_by=#{createdBy}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM question_bank_category WHERE id=#{id} AND created_by=#{createdBy}
